title: A Wasp Stings a Cockroach's Brain and Walks It Away

scenes.text: A wasp turns cockroaches into zombies.
It stings the cockroach twice. The second sting goes straight into the brain.
The roach stays awake, but it stops trying to escape.
The wasp grabs its antenna and walks it like a dog on a leash.
Then it lays an egg on the roach, and the baby wasp feeds on it.
One hour after the sting, a roach needs almost five times the shock to run. Yes, a wasp really makes zombie cockroaches.

description:
A wasp turns cockroaches into zombies.
The jewel wasp stings the roach's brain, then leads it away by the antenna.
Would you want to see this up close?
first_comment: A wasp walks a cockroach like a dog on a leash. What is the creepiest animal trick you know?
